module: Flowgraph node 'Clear Lights Dragrace' (repeat_instant category). Hides the prestage/stage and countdown lights (scene objects Prestagelight_l/r, Stagelight_l/r, Amberlight1-3_L/R, Greenlight_L/R, Redlight_L/R) as well as the 20 digit displays (display_time_i / display_speed_i), at the end or abandonment of a drag race mission.
notes: The input pin 'flow' is not tested: the node acts on every call of work.
Crashes if the scene objects (lights, displays) do not exist.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

initLights.desc: Searches the scene for the light objects and hides them all (setHidden(true)).

clearDigits.desc: Hides the displays display_time_i_l/r and display_speed_i_l/r (i from 1 to 5).

_executionStarted.desc: Clears the lights table and sets flow to false.

work.desc: Calls initLights and clearDigits on every frame of flow (no check of the input flow) and sets flow to true.
